notes: KITE SEASON. A dreamy painted storybook that never sits still. Kit (yellow raincoat) flies glowing kites with friends from a little house on a floating island in a violet dusk sky; the kite strings are the promises. Growing up snaps them one by one. When the island lands on the Milk Sea, everyone marches across the water to the beat, and on every borrowed minor-iv chord the pale milk rises, the colour drains out of the world and time itself brakes to a stop: that is numbness, never a symbol. The first hard cut drops Kit under the milk, down to a gold light that cracks open on the drum fill and lifts the world a semitone into a golden mirror lake, where Kit and June dance until she blows away as dandelion seeds and the friends settle into lit houses. The final chorus is the one big trip: the sky shatters into a kaleidoscope of every world in the film while a crowd jumps on every beat, melting and freezing on the numb chords. Then silence: grown-up Kit on a rock in the night catches the last kite, and the pull-back reveals the twist: the string still runs all the way up to the little house in the sky, where the child Kit is holding the other end. Hard stop. Look: soft painterly fields, art-directed palettes per section, glowing light, hundreds of small living things (motes, seeds, fireflies, ripples), cast drawn with scenes/lib/cast.mjs. Calm and beautiful through C1, hits hard only in D1.

timeline.brief: A1 verse (voice + pad only, no drums), frames 0-1824. KITE ISLAND AT THE VIOLET HOUR: a dreamy painted sky that is always gently alive. LAYERS back to front. (1) SKY: worldkit.field with stops [skyTop, skyMid, skyLow, horizon] (vertical bias: blend the field 60/40 with a vertical gradient so the top stays dark and the horizon warm), scale ~2, warp ~1, slow drift; overall brightness breathes with pad_lvl (+-8%). (2) STARS: ~250 tiny points (r 1-2.5) fading in over the first 30 s, each twinkling (hashed phase). (3) MOON: r 260 at (1420, 290), a cream disc cut into 9 horizontal bands with 10-14 px gaps showing the sky; alternate bands slide +-12 px on slow sines; a soft glow sprite behind (r 560, alpha 0.22 + 0.2*pad_lvl). (4) CLOUDS: three parallax banks of soft clouds (worldkit.blobPath shapes filled with cloud on top and cloudShade below, or clustered glow sprites) drifting left at 6, 12 and 22 px/s; the nearest bank passes partly in front of the island. (5) FAR ISLANDS: 5 small floating rock silhouettes (ridge tops, dangling roots) bobbing at different rates. (6) KITE ISLAND: a floating chunk of earth ~520 px wide whose grassy top is at y=700, centred at x=960; on it a little house (pale walls, pointed roof, one round glowing window, a door, a crooked chimney with a slow smoke curl), grass tufts; roots and a rope ladder dangle below and sway. The island bobs +-8 px over 4 bars. (7) CHARACTERS from scenes/lib/cast.mjs: KIT.child stands on the island flying a kite from the start. At P.friendsIn (frame 869, the I-to-we turn) FRIENDS[0..3].child and then JUNE.child run in from the island edges one per beat (puppet run cycle, then stand) and fly their own kites; between kites they hold hands in a line (armTo IK) on downbeats. GROWING UP: P.grow 0->1 (frames 1202-1313) scales every kid smoothly from child to teen height and switches to the .teen design at the midpoint. SNAPS: at P.snap0..P.snap3 (frames 1382, 1493, 1603, 1714) one friend's string snaps (a bright spark at the hand, the string whips and recoils in 0.3 s, the kite tumbles away up-left and shrinks into the sky over 3 s); that friend lowers the arm, turns and walks off the island edge out of frame over 2 s; JUNE's string snaps last (P.snap3) and she waves before leaving. Kit is left alone with one kite. TIP: P.tip 0->1 (frames 1739-1824): the camera pans down and rotates ~8 degrees, the island tilts forward, and a pale milky sea (sea colour, soft wave lines) rises from the bottom; on the last frame it fills the lower 60% of the frame (the next scene opens with the island splashing down on that sea). (8) KITES: a diamond kite (60 px tall, the owner's coat colour with a lighter cross and INK outline) high above (y 120-380) on a glowing string (a quadratic curve from the hand: use puppet.solve() joint wristR; 2 px, string colour, soft glow) with a ribbon tail of 6 bows that trails behind (draw the tail along the kite's positions at t - k*0.12 s, i.e. an echo). Kites swoop in slow figure-eights (Lissajous, period 2 bars, phase-shifted per kid) and dip on each downbeat (an impulse from F.c.since_down). (9) MOTES: every sung note (F.ev.voc_notes onsets) releases a glowing mote (glow sprite in mote colour, r 6-14 by velocity, warmer with higher pitch) from a point on Kit's kite string; it rises and drifts on a closed-form path (worldkit.particles with births from the note onsets) for 6 s and fades. Keep 40-120 alive. (10) FIREFLIES: ~60 near the island, slow wander, twinkling. MUSIC MAP: pad_lvl -> sky brightness and moon glow; voice onsets -> motes; voc_lvl -> string glow (alpha 0.5 + 0.5*voc_lvl); downbeats -> kite dips and an island bob accent; around each F.ev.dips time (frames 687 and 1564) the world holds its breath for 1.5 s (motion eases to half speed via an eased local clock, glow dims 30%). KEY FRAMES to check: 0, 60, 300, 687, 869, 900, 1100, 1202, 1260, 1313, 1382, 1400, 1493, 1564, 1603, 1714, 1740, 1790, 1824. The title card is drawn by the engine (bottom centre, 1.8-9.1 s): keep the bottom-centre area calm then. Calm and beautiful, gently moving everywhere. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev). No zoom punches, glitch or strobes.

B1 first chorus, frames 1825-2710: THE MILK SEA under a SPIRAL SUN, the first time the drums and bass are in (the bass enters on the first frame; quiet percussion builds all the way to the cut). SKY: a turquoise (skyTop) to peach (skyLow) gradient down to the horizon at y=430, with soft drifting clouds (worldkit.field low contrast or blobs). SPIRAL SUN at (960, 300), r 150: a cream disc with 6 concentric sunRing rings and a soft spiral of light (e.g. 12 curved wedges) turning slowly (one turn per 8 bars), pulsing 6% bigger on every downbeat. THE SEA: from the horizon to the bottom, 44 perspective wave strips (filled polylines, sea colour far to seaDeep near, each crest edged with a 2-5 px crest highlight), wave height = base + 30*bass_lvl px near the camera; slow travelling noise. LANDING (first 1.5 s): Kite Island from the previous scene is on the sea at (960, 600), splashing down on frame 1825: a crown of ~120 milk droplets (closed-form particles, gravity) and an expanding ring wave; then the island floats and drifts slowly right and away. CHARACTERS (cast.mjs, .teen designs): KIT, JUNE and FRIENDS step off the island and walk across the milk in a loose line toward the camera-left diagonal, in side view, walk phase locked to the beat grid (one stride per two beats: phase = F.c.mt/2), bobbing. Every kick (F.ev.kick) puts a ripple ring at the foot of the nearest walker (a perspective ellipse expanding over 0.8 s, fading). THE CROWD (we all): faceless figures (cast.crowdDesign(crowd colour, 'teen'), stamped with puppet.puppetSprite using phase-quantised keys) appear on the sea in rows behind them, recruited over the chorus from 12 to P.crowdMax (more from P.swell, frame 2457, the build), all marching in unison on the beat, smaller with distance (perspective). Hats -> sparkles: on each F.ev.hat hit, 3-6 star glints pop on random wave crests (scale up then fade over 0.25 s). Snares -> a quick shimmer along the crests. NUMB (the key idea, both windows F.ev.numb[0] frames 2157-2268 and [1] 2600-2711): THE MILK RISES. The sea surface climbs up the figures (waist-high when F.c.numb = 1; clip the lower bodies under the milk surface), the colour drains out of everything toward the milk colour (mix figures, sky and sun toward milk by 0.85*numb), the ripples stop, and TIME BRAKES: drive every animation phase (walk, waves, sun spin, clouds) with a freeze clock tau(t) = t - 0.92*F.integral('numb', S.t0, t) so the world slows to a near-stop; after each window colour returns but never fully (keep 0.25*F.c.numb_accum of the drain). The scene ends frozen and pale in the second window; the engine hard-cuts at frame 2711. KEY FRAMES: 1825, 1830, 1860, 1900, 2000, 2100, 2157, 2200, 2268, 2300, 2457, 2550, 2600, 2650, 2710. The drums must be visible: ripples on kicks, sparkles on hats, the subtle post zoom on kicks. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev).

A2 break, frames 2711-2932: UNDER THE MILK. A hard cut from the frozen pale sea to deep water, silent (pad only; the voice drops out 91.3-96.1 s and returns at P.voiceBack, frame 2883). WATER: a vertical gradient top -> mid -> bottom; a bright rippling ceiling band at y<=110 (milk-lilac with ~30 caustic lines from worldkit.waves in caustic colour); 7 god rays fanning down from the ceiling (worldkit.rays, slowly swaying); ~300 drifting particles of marine snow (snow colour, tiny, slow) and soft depth haze. KIT (cast.KIT.teen, drained: mix his fill colours 60% toward #9FB8E8) sinks slowly from y=250 to y=520 over the section in the puppet float cycle (cycles.float), slowly rotating (+-20 degrees); a stream of bubbles rises from him (closed-form particles, wobble, r 3-12). His faint glow dims while the voice is out and pulses back warm at P.voiceBack. THE GOLD LIGHT: at P.pivot (frame 2877) a gold point opens far below at (960, 980) and grows (glow sprites gold over goldCore, r 0 -> 260 by frame 2915), warming the whole water toward teal-gold (mix the gradient 35% toward gold); 3 slow rays rise from it. THE FILL: on each of the 5 drum-fill hits (F.between('hit', P.pivot, F.ev.key_changes[0].t + 0.5/F.fps); frames 2916, 2919, 2922, 2925, 2932) the light bursts: a ring of 12 short rays flashes out, the light jumps 18% bigger, and Kit is pulled 30 px toward it (eased); the post shake on hits adds the punch. On the last frame (2932) the gold light fills ~70% of the frame (the engine's gold flash on 2933 completes it). KEY FRAMES: 2711, 2712, 2740, 2800, 2860, 2877, 2883, 2900, 2916, 2919, 2922, 2925, 2930, 2932. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev).

C1 verse in the new key, frames 2933-3984: THE GOLDEN MIRROR LAKE, the warmest, most beautiful world in the film (the young-love verse). Steady drums all through, felt gently. WORLD: a golden-hour sky (worldkit.field, stops skyTop/skyMid/skyLow, low contrast, slow) with a huge low sun (r 180, sun colour, big sunGlow glow, slow soft rays) whose height follows P.sunY; the horizon is at y=560; below it a still lake that MIRRORS the world: draw everything above the horizon into a layer (g.layer), then draw it flipped below the horizon, darkened 35% toward lake colour, with a horizontal ripple distortion (redraw it in ~60 thin horizontal slices offset by small sine waves, amplitude boosted by snare impulses). FOREGROUND: a dandelion meadow along the bottom (y > 860): ~260 stems (stem colour) swaying with the beat (a 4-degree sway on beat_phase, phase-shifted by x) topped by white seed puffs (stamped cached sprites); ~80 fireflies (firefly colour) wandering and twinkling on hats; loose seeds drifting across the frame all the time (closed-form particles). ARRIVAL: on the first frame Kit (KIT.teen) and June (JUNE.teen) burst up out of the lake at centre (splash rings on the water, droplets) and wade to the shore (2 s), then walk along the shore together hand in hand (side view, walk phase locked to mt/2, armTo IK for the joined hands), then from ~frame 3050 dance facing each other (cycles.dance 'sway', phase = beat_phase) in the middle third of the frame. DRUMS: each kick makes 1-3 nearby puffs release a burst of 10-20 seeds; snares ripple the reflection; hits pulse the sun glow +15%. FEELINGS GONE at P.feelingsGone (frame 3195): June dissolves into ~300 dandelion seeds sampled from her silhouette (head, body, limbs), which blow away up-right and out of frame over 3 s while Kit reaches after them (puppet.armTo toward the seeds). SETTLING at P.settle (frame 3310): along the far shore (y ~540-560, small in the distance) little houses appear one per downbeat (8 houses, from the left), their windows lighting warm; FRIENDS[0..3].teen sit in pairs on benches in front of the nearest two (poses.sit, placed with y). Kit walks alone along the shore (slow walk, phase mt/4). HELD ii (P.heldIi -> P.home, frames 3708-3874): the sun sinks (P.sunY) and the sky deepens toward plum. HOME at P.home and the confession P.confess (frames 3874-3897+): seeds swirl back out of the sky and form June's silhouette among the clouds for ~2 s (a ghostly constellation of seeds, alpha 0.7), then scatter. LAST BAR from P.crackT0 (frame 3929): fine bright cracks (crack colour, 1-3 px, branching polylines) spread across the sky from the sun, faster and faster, setting up the next scene's shatter on frame 3985. KEY FRAMES: 2933, 2940, 2990, 3050, 3100, 3195, 3220, 3260, 3310, 3400, 3500, 3708, 3800, 3874, 3897, 3929, 3960, 3984. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev). No strobes, glitch or kaleidoscope here (save them for the next scene).

D1 final chorus, frames 3985-4925: THE KALEIDOSCOPE STORM, the ONE BIG TRIP of the film and the loudest section. It must stay beautiful and in the film's own palette (plum, rose, gold, milk, teal, violet, peach), never rainbow neon or raw fractal noise. The short cut of the video starts here (from frame 3970 with a fade from black), so the first seconds must grab. SOURCE LAYER (g.layer): a melting colour field (worldkit.field, stops in plum/violet/rose/peach/gold, warp ~1.6, colour cycle offset slowly sliding by 0.02 per bar, NOT a full-spectrum cycle) with the film's motifs flying through it: kites with ribbon tails, dandelion seeds, the banded moon, the spiral sun, waves of milk, gold rays. THE KALEIDOSCOPE: fx.kaleido of that layer with 8 wedges (12 after P.loudest), rotating slowly and jumping +15 degrees (eased over 0.15 s) on each downbeat; it fills the frame. At frame 3985 the sky SHATTERS into it: the first 0.4 s show shards of the previous gold sky flying outward (polygon shards with an echo trail) as the kaleidoscope opens behind them. FOREGROUND: a huge crowd of adult silhouettes (cast.crowdDesign(crowd, 'adult') stamped with puppet.puppetSprite, 300-600 figures in perspective rows across the bottom 45% of the frame) JUMPING IN UNISON on every beat (cycles.jump with u = beat_phase, quantised to 12 keys for sprite reuse), with KIT.adult in colour at the centre front, arms up. LIGHT BEAMS: 6 beams (worldkit.rays or long gradient wedges in beam colour) sweep across the sky, flicking to a new angle on each hit. KITES: on each snare, a kite streaks across the frame (a fast diagonal with a long ribbon). NUMB (F.ev.numb[2] frames 4372-4483 and [3] 4816-4926): the kaleidoscope MELTS (fx.melt with amount 0 -> 220 px following F.c.numb) and drains toward milk; the crowd FREEZES at the top of the jump (freeze clock tau(t) = t - 0.95*F.integral('numb', S.t0, t) drives every phase); after numb[2] ends (frame 4483) everything slams back on the beat. LOUDEST at P.loudest (frame 4777): a white-gold bloom burst (the engine flashes too) and the kaleidoscope opens to 12 wedges. The final numb window drains everything to milk white and freezes it; the engine hard-cuts at frame 4926 while it is still frozen. KEY FRAMES: 3970, 3985, 3990, 3998, 4050, 4150, 4300, 4372, 4420, 4483, 4486, 4600, 4777, 4780, 4816, 4870, 4925. Drums must drive it: jumps on beats, beams on hits, kites on snares, post zoom on kicks. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev).

E1 outro, frames 4926-5146 (the engine blacks out every frame from 5099, the pad's hard stop; nothing needs drawing after that but draw normally anyway). THE LAST KITE, and the twist. A hard cut from the frozen white storm to a quiet night: a deep indigo sky (skyTop to skyLow) with ~400 stars, some twinkling; no drums. GROWN-UP KIT (cast.KIT.adult, front view, small: 160 px) stands alone on a small floating rock (rock colour, ~200 px wide) at the centre of the frame. A single glowing kite (kite colour, the same diamond with the ribbon tail as the first scene) drifts down from the top of the frame on a glowing string. The voice's last notes (F.ev.voc_notes after S.t0; onsets at frames 4939, 4946, 4949) each make the kite glow pulse. At P.catch (frame 4960, the voice's exit) Kit reaches up (puppet.armTo IK) and catches the string. THE TWIST (P.pull 1 -> 0.32 and P.tilt 0 -> 1 over the rest of the outro): the camera slowly pulls back and tilts up along the string. The string runs up and up into the sky, and at its top end is the little floating house from the first scene (same shapes and palette as the dusk scene's Kite Island: pale walls, pointed roof, one glowing round window), and in the glowing window the CHILD Kit (cast.KIT.child, small) is holding the other end of the same string. Both are visible together by ~frame 5080: the adult on the rock at the bottom, the child in the window at the top, one glowing string between them. Everything stays still and quiet except the kite's tail, the stars and a slow breathing glow on the string (pad_lvl). KEY FRAMES: 4926, 4930, 4939, 4960, 4990, 5030, 5080, 5098. Must NOT: no text or lyrics; no TV heads or symbolic heads; no rainbow-neon colour cycling or raw full-screen fractals; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times (use P and F.ev). No fade (the engine's hard stop is the ending).

transitions.why: the island splashes down on the Milk Sea with the bass entry
drums and bass stop: hard cut under the milk
the gold light bursts open on the key change
the sky shatters into the final-chorus trip
band out: hard cut to the night
